fichas.title: Glass Blocks
fichas.summary: Hollow glass units made by melting and pressing two sections together to form a sealed air cavity. They may be transparent, translucent, diffusing, low-glare, decorative, or coloured. The page covers uses, fire resistance, thermal and acoustic properties, installation details, block sizes, minimum radii, and limits for unreinforced walls. Glass block walls are non-load-bearing. The minimum structural opening is expressed by the formulas A = n₁·b + n₂·a, B = A + 2·c, and H = A + c + d; these formulas are retained as text rather than treated as numeric dimensions.
